description: Create a webhook subscription for event notifications. Events: screenshot.completed (batch job done), quota.warning (80% used), quota.exceeded (100% used), capture.completed and change.detected (scheduled captures). Max 5 webhooks per account. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256. Save the returned secret to verify signatures.

url.description: Webhook endpoint URL. Must be a public HTTPS URL.

name: create_webhook
